name: Haramase Saimin Princess
original_name: 孕ませ催眠プリンセス
source:
Main character is a hired manager of a small hotel. Country's princess runs away with her closest female knight from political marriage and stays at this hotel to rest. Protagonist gets a super strong aphrodisiac drug from black market and serves it to princess with wine...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一家小旅馆的受雇经理。国家的公主与她最亲近的女骑士从政治联姻中逃走，住在这家酒店休息。主角从黑市买到超强催情药，并用酒招待公主……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
